summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. All 40 label-free DDA .raw files are annotated with a dose group encoded in each deposited file name and corroborated by the deposited Progenesis export and Skyline SRM sheet. Instrument and acquisition values were re-confirmed from 4 raw-file headers the reviewer fetched independently, and all 6 declared modifications are supported by the protocol or by the deposited peptide export. Four minor findings remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent context; did not read the producer report.md or transcript; PRIDE record, file list, peptide export, SRM xlsx, raw headers and Berle et al. 2013 re-fetched into scratchpad/PXD004362/review-PXD004362/

spec_compliance.evidence: Active templates derived independently: ms-proteomics 1.1.0 (MS technology layer) + vertebrates 1.1.0 (Gadus morhua is a non-human vertebrate); both latest in templates.yaml and both declared. parse_sdrf validate-sdrf --use_ols_cache_only exit 0 'Everything seems to be fine' for each template. sdrf-tools structure: 'Structure OK'. 40 rows x 40 columns, uniform width; source name, assay name and data file each unique; column order sample -> data -> factor. Only deviation from guidance: disease reserved word (minor finding).

ontology_integrity.evidence: Live OLS4 resolved, non-obsolete, label-exact: MS:1003096 Orbitrap Velos Pro; MS:1000083 radial ejection linear ion trap; MS:1000133 collision-induced dissociation; MS:1001251 Trypsin; PRIDE:0000627 Data-dependent acquisition; CHEBI:34202 2,2',4,4',5,5'-hexachlorobiphenyl; UBERON:0002107 liver; UBERON:0034919 juvenile stage (present in EFO, satisfying the vertebrates EFO validator); NCBITaxon:8049 Gadus morhua; UNIMOD:1 Acetyl, 4 Carbamidomethyl, 35 Oxidation, 26 Pyro-carbamidomethyl, 27 Glu->pyro-Glu, 28 Gln->pyro-Glu, with TA/PP consistent with Unimod specificities. sdrf-tools check: 14/14 verified, 0 hallucinated, 0 label mismatches, 0 UNIMOD swaps.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE PXD004362 record (title and accession asserted) supports organism, liver, juvenile mixed-gender fish, i.p. vehicle/0.5/2/8 mg/kg PCB 153 with n=10 per group, 14-day sacrifice, trypsin, label-free MS1 quantification on LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro, NCE 35%, 10 ppm/0.5 Da, Carbamidomethyl C fixed and Oxidation M variable. Europe PMC abstract for PMID 28183064 agrees on doses, 2-week exposure and label-free design. Raw headers fetched by the reviewer (OAK_K_3, OAK_05_7, OAK_2_4, OAK_8_9; first 400 KB) show Creator 'Orbitrap Velos Pro', 'Nth Order Double Play', FTMS + p norm o(300.0-2000.0), ITMS Dep MS/MS top 7, CID at NCE 35.0. Deposited peptide export (byte-identical to the producer cache) lists 469 'oxidation of m', 56 'pyro-glu from n-term q', 47 'acetylation of protein n-term', 29 'pyro-cmc' and 1 'pyro-glu from n-term e'. These 4 extra modifications are X!Tandem's quick-acetyl/quick-pyrolidone defaults, so they were part of the deposited search space.

file_mapping.evidence: The PRIDE file list (all projectAccessions = PXD004362) contains 40 .raw files; the SDRF references exactly those 40 with no duplicates, no unmatched files and no peak lists. Every row satisfies data file = assay name + '.raw', and the dose matches the file-name token (K -> 0, 05 -> 0.5, 2 -> 2, 8 -> 8 mg/kg). The biological replicate equals the trailing index. The token-to-group reading is corroborated by the deposited Progenesis export (Ctr_1..10, PCB153_0.5mg_1..10, 2mg_1..10, 8mg_1..10 = 40 runs) and by the Skyline SRM ReplicateName values (K-1..K-10 for controls, 2_n, 8_n). Raw headers carry no sample-ID field, so the file name is the only per-run evidence; it explicitly encodes the group, so this is not an invented mapping. Not annotated: the SRM container 20130705_SAmples.wiff (+ .wiff.scan); see minor finding.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 4 dose groups x 10 fish = 40 individuals = 40 runs; technical replicate 1 and fraction 1 throughout (one unfractionated 90-min injection per liver); factor value[dose] equals characteristics[dose] on every row; compound is 'not applicable' exactly when dose is 0 mg/kg. All technical columns are constant, matching one method file (TOP7_Labelfree_10minDelay_90minRUN.meth) in every inspected raw file, all acquired in one 20111111_LabelFree batch. No hidden confounders found in the deposited evidence.

omission_safety.evidence: Every non-reserved value traces to PRIDE protocol, raw header, deposited search export or OLS. Unknowns (sex per fish, strain/stock, reduction/alkylation reagents) are 'not available' rather than guessed. The 4 X!Tandem-only modifications are backed by identified PSMs in the deposited export, so they are not unsupported additions. Material omissions found (DTT/IAA in the cited protocol, the vehicle composition, the SRM sub-experiment) are each minor and listed below.

deterministic_validation.evidence: timeout 900 .venv/bin/parse_sdrf validate-sdrf --sdrf_file <artifact> --template ms-proteomics --use_ols_cache_only -> exit 0; same with --template vertebrates -> exit 0; python -m tools check -> CLEAN (14/14), exit 0; python -m tools score -> 100/100, exit 0; python -m tools structure -> Structure OK, exit 0; python -m tools reconcile --record pride.json --accession PXD004362 -> 'every annotated value agrees with the deposit record', exit 0. No term relied on cache-only resolution; all were also confirmed live in OLS4.

findings.location: file-level: PRIDE files 20130705_SAmples.wiff and 20130705_SAmples.wiff.scan (fileCategory RAW) are not referenced
findings.message: The SRM verification sub-experiment (QTRAP 5500, SIS-spiked) is not annotated. Leaving it out is acceptable for this SDRF. Optionally provide a separate SRM SDRF.
findings.evidence: The SDRF row/assay model does not fit the deposit cleanly: one .wiff container holds 29 injections, and the Skyline sheet SRMSkylineresults_PCB153.xlsx lists 29 ReplicateNames (K-1..K-10, 2_1..2_10 without 2_7, 8_1..8_10; no 0.5 mg/kg group). These would need rows sharing one data file and assay name, with comment[associated data file] for the .wiff.scan. The SRM uses a different instrument and acquisition (PRIDE:0000630), so it does not belong in these DDA rows. The omission is disclosed in the manifest limitations, and nothing asserted for the 40 DDA rows depends on it.

findings.location: comment[reduction reagent], comment[alkylation reagent] rows 1-40 ('not available')
findings.message: Reagents are recoverable from the cited protocol reference. Consider OLS-verified dithiothreitol (DTT) and iodoacetamide (IAA) terms, or keep 'not available' and add a note.
findings.evidence: PRIDE protocol: digestion and purification 'as described previously (Berle et al. Fluids and barriers of the CNS 10, 17. 2013)'. Berle et al. 2013 (PMC3641952, open access) Methods: 'dissolved in 6 M Urea and 100 mM DTT ... Cysteins were alkylated using 200 mM iodoacetamide'. The Carbamidomethyl fixed search is consistent with IAA. 'not available' is safe but under-uses evidence that is available.

findings.message: The vertebrates and sample-metadata template documentation say to use 'normal' (PATO:0000461) for healthy/control animals. 'not applicable' passes validation but departs from that convention.
findings.evidence: vertebrates/1.1.0/vertebrates.yaml documentation: 'characteristics[disease]: Required ... Use `normal` for healthy animals'; sample-metadata: 'Use normal (PATO:0000461) for healthy/control samples'. The PRIDE protocol describes acclimated, fed juvenile fish with no disease variable.

findings.location: comment[modification parameters] columns 3-6 (Acetyl Protein N-term, Gln->pyro-Glu, Glu->pyro-Glu, Pyro-carbamidomethyl) rows 1-40
findings.message: These 4 modifications are supported, but they are X!Tandem quick-acetyl/quick-pyrolidone defaults applied by only one of the three engines (X!Tandem, MS Amanda, MS-GF+). They are not in the authors' stated parameter list. The declared set is therefore a superset of what MS Amanda and MS-GF+ searched; SDRF cannot express per-engine mods, so a note is the right correction.
findings.evidence: PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol lists only 'carbamidomethyl Cys as fixed modification; oxidation of Met as variable modification'. The deposited PCB153_Ensembl_MSGF_Amanda_Xt_Peptides.csv contains validated peptides with exactly these 4 modifications (47/56/1/29). TA/PP values match Unimod and X!Tandem semantics (protein N-term +42; peptide N-term Q/E/cam-C cyclisation).
